title: 11e Multigaming — FR/EN Gaming Community on Discord
description: Join the 11e multigaming Discord: a French and English-speaking community born in Foxhole, playing co-op, survival and strategy games together.

hero.body: Born in Foxhole, our gaming community meets on Discord to play co-op, survive, build and explore other worlds. The games change. The joy of playing together stays.
hero.caption: NEXT DESTINATION

community.title:
Come for a game.
Stay for the people.
community.body: The 11e brings French and English-speaking gamers together on Discord. We love a well-laid plan as much as a night that goes off the rails, cooperative sessions and helping each other along the way.

items.title: Find your team
items.body: A squad to complete, a crew to join, a world to build: there is a place for you.

items.title: Play at your pace
items.body: Start a session, return to a favourite or discover a new game. You do not have to stick to one battlefield.

items.title: Share more than a game
items.body: Voice chats, conversations, helping hands and good memories are part of the adventure, too.

origins.title:
A regiment.
A whole community.
origins.body: The 11e’s story began on Foxhole’s battlefields, fighting for the Wardens. Logistics, operations and long evenings built friendships that reach far beyond the front lines.
origins.body2: We bring that same spirit wherever we go: work together, help each other and make great stories along the way.
origins.caption: FOXHOLE / WHERE IT ALL BEGAN

heritage.title: A 35-hour week, beyond the trenches.
heritage.body: A “union” for the 11e RC, salt mines and even a “church of salt”: our Discord has its own folklore, born from Foxhole and the players’ sense of humour. Behind the demands for a 35-hour week lies a simple wish: to get together in other games.
heritage.quote: “We deserve a life outside the trenches and want to discover other games!”
heritage.caption: The original poster · 11eFO
heritage.alt: Historical 11eFO poster on a red background: a figure carries a flag and raises a hammer.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms cover the official instance of 11eNexus, the 11e community’s Discord bot, and this website. By using the service, you accept these terms.

sections.title: The service and its operator
paragraphs: NapoSky operates 11eNexus as a free, non-commercial community project. The bot helps authorised members discover, create or revive game spaces, choose notifications and take part in server events.
Nexus is independent of Discord, Valve and the publishers of the games shown. Their presence here does not imply a partnership or endorsement.

sections.title: Access and rules
paragraphs: You must follow Discord’s Terms of Service and Community Guidelines, the server rules and the minimum age required by Discord and the laws of your country. Member features require the relevant server roles; administration features are restricted to authorised people.
Installing and configuring the bot requires permission from the server administration. Public source code is not an invitation to install the official instance on another server.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not use Nexus to harass anyone, post unlawful content, infringe others’ rights, send abusive notifications, bypass permissions or limits, or compromise the service. Do not submit sensitive data in proposals, event descriptions or public issues.
Quotas and server capacities may limit game creation or revival. Requested notifications remain subject to recipients’ preferences and Discord’s rules.

sections.title: Your content and archives
paragraphs: You keep your rights to submitted content and authorise its processing to perform the requested action. Announcements and event descriptions are visible to people with access to the corresponding channels.

Archiving hides a channel; it does not erase its history. Administrators remain responsible for permissions and moderation. Permanently deleting an archived event requires explicit administrative confirmation.
The Privacy Policy explains the data we keep and how to exercise your rights.

sections.title: Availability, changes and access
paragraphs: The service is provided on a best-effort basis, without an availability commitment. Maintenance, failures, Discord changes and API limits may interrupt it. Features may change.
Access may be restricted or suspended to protect the community or in response to abuse. Data processing and retention remain subject to the Privacy Policy.

To the extent permitted by law, the service is provided without warranty and its operator is not liable for indirect losses caused by unavailability. Nothing limits rights or liabilities that cannot legally be limited.

sections.title: Support, reports and changes
paragraphs: For questions or abuse reports, contact NapoSky through the repository’s GitHub issues. Issues are public: request a private exchange before sharing personal data or security details. You can also contact the 11e Discord administration directly.

The date on this page is updated when the terms change. The text and its history are available in the repository. French law governs these terms, without prejudice to mandatory protections in your country.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy covers the official 11eNexus instance and multigaming.11e-foxhole.com. It describes the bot’s operation; operators of other instances must publish their own policies.

sections.title: Controller and contact
paragraphs: NapoSky is responsible for processing by the official instance. The public contact is the repository’s GitHub issues. For a personal request, open an issue without sensitive data to arrange a private exchange, or contact the 11e Discord administration. Do not post your identifier, private messages, tokens or data exports in a public issue.

sections.title: Data processed and purposes
paragraphs: The bot receives Discord identifiers for the server, members, roles, channels and interactions. It checks roles and permissions to respond to authorised actions. It stores associations between games, channels, roles and messages it manages, together with notification subscription preferences.

Game proposals include the author’s identifier, the submitted name and link, language, dates, status and administrative responses. Events retain their name, description, associated game, Discord resources and creation or closure state.

Temporary sessions and quota timestamps support private navigation and abuse prevention. Audit and operation records contain the action, target, actor identifiers where needed and dates required to recover interrupted operations.

To assess game activity, Nexus observes human-message timestamps and channel and thread metadata without storing conversation text. It does not request the privileged message content intent, record voice conversations or track game presence.

sections.title: Why we process data
paragraphs: Data needed for requested features is processed to provide the service. Permission checks, abuse prevention, security and operation recovery serve the legitimate interest of running a reliable community service. Notifications are optional and can be disabled by removing the relevant role or using Nexus.
Data is not sold, used for advertising or used to train an artificial intelligence model. Archiving is based on activity in game spaces, without individual member profiling.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: Open requests expire after 30 days without an update. Closed requests are kept for 30 days after closure. Audit entries, terminal operations and old rate-limit timestamps are cleaned after 30 days. Sessions are removed at expiry.

Unresolved operations, catalogue associations, import receipts and data needed to operate games and events remain while necessary. Subscription preferences follow Discord roles; manual removals and server departures are taken into account during reconciliation. Legacy records without lifecycle dates have a 30-day transition period from retention activation.

Channel histories remain on Discord under server and Discord rules. Archiving a game or event does not delete its messages. Backups and technical logs may retain copies; their rotation depends on hosting. NapoSky can explain remaining copies when handling a request; we do not promise instant deletion from every backup.

sections.title: Recipients and external services
paragraphs: The operator and authorised administrators access data needed for management and support. Exchanges and publications use Discord under its own Privacy Policy.

The bot queries RAWG to search titles and retrieve game details and images. The searched game name is sent to RAWG without adding a Discord member identifier. Images are retrieved from artwork providers. The bot runs on the operator’s infrastructure.

This static website is served by GitHub Pages. Images and fonts are hosted with the site; no Discord or video embed loads automatically. The site adds no cookies, local storage or analytics. GitHub may process connection data, including IP addresses, to serve and secure the site. Following a link to Discord, GitHub or another service opens an environment governed by its own policy. These providers may process data outside your country under their respective safeguards.

sections.title: Your rights and security
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and, where applicable, portability by contacting NapoSky. Identity verification is limited to what is necessary. Legal exceptions or unresolved operations will be explained if retention remains necessary.

Disabling notifications does not automatically delete a proposal or audit entry. Leaving the server does not erase messages you posted there; these are also managed by Discord and the server administration.

You may complain to the CNIL or your competent supervisory authority. Access to the bot and its data is restricted to authorised people; application logs filter secrets, request bodies and raw error messages. If a data breach occurs, required notifications will be made to affected people and authorities.

sections.title: Policy changes
paragraphs: The date on this page identifies its version. Changes are preserved in the public repository history. Material changes in processing will be communicated to members through appropriate community channels.

faq.title: A gaming community. A place to belong.
faq.body: A few pointers to find players and start your next adventure on Discord.

items.question: How do I join the 11e multigaming Discord?
items.answer: Use the “Join our Discord” button on this page, read the server rules and introduce yourself to the community. The server explains its access requirements, and the team can help you find your game spaces.

items.question: Does the 11e only play Foxhole?
items.answer: Our community started in Foxhole, but its players also meet across many other games. Co-op, survival, strategy and exploration all have a place on our multigaming Discord.

items.question: Which games can I find in the community?
items.answer: The catalogue includes Helldivers 2, Valheim, Stellaris, Barotrauma, Project Zomboid and Star Citizen, among others. The current-games selection is dated; find players’ latest interests and activity on Discord.

items.question: Can I join the community in French or English?
items.answer: The 11e brings French and English-speaking players together. The website and Nexus bot offer French and English flows to help everyone find their games and choose notifications.

items.question: How do I find players for a game and choose notifications?
items.answer: Once you have the relevant server access, use Nexus on Discord to explore the catalogue and find game channels. Notifications are optional: choose the games you want to follow and remove subscriptions whenever you wish.
